title: We Rebuilt 90s Road Rash in Vanilla JavaScript
hookText: Mobile games in 2024 have 50GB downloads. We built this in ONE HTML file 💀

scenes.visual: Instant high-speed gameplay footage: player motorcycle doing 140mph over a pseudo-3D hill, pulling alongside a rival rider and landing a brutal right hook. Heavy crunch hit-stop sound effect.
scenes.voiceover: Remember when motorcycle games let you punch people off their bikes?
scenes.onScreenText: We rebuilt 90s Road Rash in pure JavaScript 💀

scenes.visual: Rapid cuts of intense highway action: weaving between oncoming semi-trucks, hitting elevation crests with OutRun-style raster scaling, and tire smoke drifting around sharp mountain corners.
scenes.voiceover: We rebuilt that exact arcade feel directly in the browser. Zero game engine, pure canvas math.
scenes.onScreenText: Pseudo-3D raster curves • 60 FPS in browser

scenes.visual: Player grabs a roadside club, pulls up between two rival riders, swings left and right, sending both tumbling into the guardrails while dodging an oncoming red sports car by inches.
scenes.voiceover: Five rival riders, elevation hills, oncoming traffic, and full melee combat.

scenes.visual: Final stretch: Leader pulls up, tries to kick player. Player time-parries with a club swing, launching the leader into an oncoming bus right as the CHECKERED FLAG drops.
scenes.voiceover: Time your swings, take the corners, and knock out first place.

scenes.visual: Quick cut to a smartphone browser opening the tab instantly with zero loading screen, game runs immediately at full speed. URL clearly visible on screen.
scenes.voiceover: Play free right now in your mobile or desktop browser on Kreeda.games. No downloads, zero ads.

caption: Throwing hands at 140 MPH on a browser highway 🏍️💨 We built a full Road Rash style arcade brawler using zero engines and pure JavaScript math. Play instantly on phone or PC (no install, no ads).
